name: modulr
description: Plugins for marketers and operators who want to sound like themselves at scale.

plugins.name: modulr-voice-os
plugins.description: Email drafting OS that sounds like you, not AI. Wizard-driven setup, anti-AI gate, citation discipline.

plugins.name: modulr-beehiiv-list-hygiene
plugins.description: Build a beehiiv exclusion segment of burner/disposable domains, typo'd free providers, and (optionally) role-based or dormant subscribers. Cleans deliverability drag with one command.

plugins.name: modulr-beehiiv-teardown
plugins.description: Teardown a published beehiiv post against a rolling baseline. Open rate, CTR, link heatmap, and the single highest-leverage change for the next send.

plugins.name: modulr-beehiiv-voice-mine
plugins.description: Reverse-engineer a brand-voice profile from your top-performing beehiiv posts. Bootstraps or diffs voice-os/context/brand-voice.md.

plugins.name: modulr-beehiiv-segment-builder
plugins.description: Translate plain-English audience descriptions into saved beehiiv segments. Parses, previews size, and saves via the MCP — no condition-builder dance.

plugins.name: modulr-beehiiv-subscriber-language
plugins.description: Mine free-text from beehiiv polls and surveys into a structured subscriber-language file — fears, desires, objections, and exact vocabulary, with attribution.

plugins.name: modulr-beehiiv-cadence
plugins.description: Newsletter cadence and topic-gap report. Pulls last 60-90 days of beehiiv sends and recommends a specific next-2-weeks plan with topic, format, and send slot.

plugins.name: modulr-skills
plugins.description: A growing collection of standalone skills MODULR uses in production. Steal anything useful. Includes anti-ai-phrases, price-check, email-engagement-analysis, email-deliverability, and musk-algorithm.
